description: Question-text-based bucket (unlike Phase 2/4/5 which are topic-only). Sampled at runtime: pick one category, then pick one question within it.

questions: What would you say is your biggest weakness as an engineer?
What are your three biggest strengths and three biggest weaknesses?
What aspects of your work get criticized most often, and how do you respond to that feedback?
What words would your colleagues use to describe you?
What strengths do you think matter most for this role?
Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a teammate. How did you resolve it?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager or a senior person's decision.
Describe a time someone pushed back on your technical approach. What did you do?
How do you generally handle disagreements with coworkers?
Tell me about a time you had to influence someone who didn't agree with you.
Tell me about a time you failed at work or made a significant mistake.
Describe a bug or incident you caused. How did you handle it?
Tell me about a time you missed a deadline. What happened?
What's something you'd do differently if you could redo it?
Tell me about a time you had to deliver under a very tight deadline.
Describe how you prioritize when everything feels urgent at once.
Tell me about a time your workload became overwhelming. How did you manage it?
Tell me about a time you showed leadership, even without a formal title.
Describe a time you did something outside your defined responsibilities.
Tell me about a time you mentored or helped a struggling teammate.
Tell me about a time you had to make a decision without having all the information you needed.
Describe a situation where the requirements were unclear. How did you proceed?
How do you approach a problem when you're not sure of the right solution?
Tell me about a time you worked well as part of a team to deliver something.
Describe a project that required close collaboration across multiple teams.
Tell me about a time you had to explain a technical concept to a non-technical person.
Tell me about the most constructive feedback you've received. How did you act on it?
How do you typically respond when someone criticizes your code or approach?
Why do you want to work here?
What are you looking for in your next role?
Why do you want to leave your current company?
Tell me about a time you had to quickly learn an unfamiliar technology.
What's something you've taught yourself recently, and why?
Tell me about the most difficult technical problem you've solved recently.
Tell me about your proudest accomplishment in your career so far.
Walk me through a recent project and the impact it had.
What's the most interesting project you've worked on, and why?
Tell me about a time you took ownership of a problem that wasn't technically your responsibility.
Describe a time you had to admit an error to your manager or a client.
